code.description:
The problem code of its error (`SH1002`), or of its failure when
it ran and failed on the setup (`doctor`); `shuyi explain <code>`
prints its page.

error.description: Why it could not run, if it could not.

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

limits.description: What it could not determine, in plain words.

ok.description:
Whether it passed: nothing found by a check, runs that agree, a
game made, a toolchain complete. False too when it could not run.

result.description: What it found or made; absent when it could not run.

Class.description: A code's class: what kind of fix it asks for.

oneOf.description: The arguments or the input are wrong: change the command.

The project file or the toolchain needs fixing: fix it, then run
the same command again.
A file of the game's content has a problem.
The operation failed on something else.

entries.description: The code asked for, or every code in order.

class.description: Its class, which sets the exit code.

exit_code.description: The exit code of an error with it.

help.description: How to fix it, in a line.

name.description: Its kebab-case name (`missing-file`), as stable as the code.

page.description: Its page, in Markdown, when one code was asked for.

retired.description: Whether it is retired: no error gives it any more.

title.description: What went wrong, in a few words.
